TwinTail — Rust third-party dependency license texts
Scope: all 206 third-party package versions in Cargo.lock, including dev/build, optional and non-host-target packages. This is a conservative superset of the five release binaries.
Collection: Cargo.lock, offline Linux cargo metadata and registry source cache, supplemented by ten exact-version official static.crates.io archives verified against Cargo.lock SHA256 and the fixed published-VCS-commit upstream LICENSE for uuid-simd/vsimd. Network retrieval used verified TLS; supplemental provenance appears in each affected entry.
License expressions are recorded as published (legacy slash syntax retained). Where MIT or Apache-2.0 is offered as an alternative, select MIT when available; otherwise select Apache-2.0. Conjunctive requirements and additional notices remain applicable. All discovered legal files, including alternative-license texts, are reproduced for preservation; reproduction does not elect every alternative.
Each Source file label is relative to the named published package; explicitly labeled Upstream source file entries refer to the pinned upstream repository instead. No local filesystem locations are recorded. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for collection scope and provenance. All 206 package versions have reproduced original legal text.
